appendix: **Edit Mode turns.** In a Console Edit Mode turn, `.claude/skills/configure-console-product/scripts/edit-turn.mjs push` pushes the branch and finds or opens the draft pull request itself, with this run's token for that repository: do not call `open_pull_request` as well. The sandbox's own pre-push hook still runs after the turn's gate and still refuses the default branch.
requires_mcp_reason: agents/vivillon.md works through Console's HTTP API and git; no MCP server. It creates each new app's repository from prismteam-ai/configuration-bundle-template with Enact's create_repository tool (docs/repositories.md, "New repositories").
